responsibility: Declares the Storage API for heap allocation, deallocation, reallocation, and storage-availability checks used by the GNU Modula-2 boot runtime. It is the public memory-management interface consumed by dynamic containers and runtime services, abstracting over the platform-specific SysStorage implementation.
same_name_distinction: This header differs from GStorage.cc by exposing just the public heap-management entry points and types for callers. It does not implement the forwarding of allocate/deallocate/reallocate/availability requests to GSysStorage that the .cc file performs.
